#### What this PR does / why we need it:

fixes #103440

There is a dependency cycle in the scheduler app setup code. The scheduler options [embeds the default config](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5fe522c2376e9a732a50c89f38986ce4300fd4a0/cmd/kube-scheduler/app/options/options.go#L71-L77), but the default config's default values depend on the feature gates options.

I think this disables other feature gate controlled logic in the defaulting too: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5fe522c2376e9a732a50c89f38986ce4300fd4a0/pkg/scheduler/apis/config/v1beta2/defaults.go#L263-L268

ah, found there is a cycle here:

The scheduler options [embeds the default config](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5fe522c2376e9a732a50c89f38986ce4300fd4a0/cmd/kube-scheduler/app/options/options.go#L71-L77), but the default config's default values depend on the feature gates options.

I think this disables other feature gate controlled logic in the defaulting too: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5fe522c2376e9a732a50c89f38986ce4300fd4a0/pkg/scheduler/apis/config/v1beta2/defaults.go#L263-L268
@Huang-Wei @ahg-g I tried to fix it by updating the component config after the CLI flags (including the feature gates) are parsed: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103460 PTAL
#103468 fixed the flake. https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#gce-cos-master-alpha-features&width=20 is back green now.

review_comments: We may need to ensure the feature gates get always parsed firstly. If you don't mind, I opened #103468 to fix this issue from another angle.
